Abstract
        

The balanced chromatic number of a signed graph G^\widehat{G} is the minimum number of balanced sets that cover all vertices of GG. Studying structural conditions which implies bound on the balanced chromatic number of signed graphs then is among the most fundamental problems in graph theory. Considering the class of complete graphs, any such set FF must also contain a complete graph. Gyárfás and Sumner, independently, conjectured, in [7] and [14], that any such pair is enough for Forbi​n​d⁡(F)\Forb_{ind}{(F)} to have a bounded chromatic number:



Gyárfás-Sumner conjecture.



For any forest FF and any complete graph KtK_{t} the class Forbi​n​d⁡{F,Kt}\Forb_{ind}{\{F,K_{t}\}} has a bounded chromatic number.





The goal of this work is to consider potential extensions of this conjecture and related results to the class of signed graphs. To this end, we first introduce the notions and concepts.
